''See also: [[Aion Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Aion, also known as the [[Aion Sea]], is a vast and treacherous ocean formed after the death-throes of [[Nakothi]] leveled a continent. It is characterized by its supernatural and unpredictable nature, where the bizarre is more common than the natural. The sea is divided into different zones, including a shallow area for less experienced sailors and a Deep Aion{{!}}deep Aion filled with unknowable terrors. The depths are home to ancient [[Elders]], various monsters and phantoms, rogue [[Kameira]], and dangerous creatures like the [[Aion Quail]]. Some islands within the sea are actually the massive, floating corpses of [[Great Elders]], such as the [[Dead Mother]]. The Aion is a place where power, [[blood]], and conflict attract unspeakable entities, and its environment can produce phenomena such as upward-raining [[water]] or mysterious sparks that guide lost vessels. Because of its extreme hazards, specialized Navigators use unique ships—often constructed with parts of [[Elderspawn]] to help guide them—to traverse these waters safely.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Aion is a vast body of [[water]] where [[Elders]] stir and from which Elder creatures can be summoned. Navigators typically cross this region using [[Elderspawn]] guides, though the [[Consultants]] once traveled through it quickly without such assistance. The waters are filled with hazards like wormclouds and nocturnal creatures that hunt by being lured to a glow on the surface, as well as entities capable of sensing an approaching [[Lyathatan]]. While Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten has sailed these waters for years following his exile, the [[Children of Nakothi]] have also been spotted swimming around the Aion, which contains an island at its center.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Aion is a vast blue expanse situated at a depth beneath the debris field. This region contains numerous floating islands, and rumors suggest that [[Nakothi]] waits at its very bottom. After scouts reported the presence of a Navigator’s ship{{!}}Navigator's ship within the expanse, a [[Navigator]] set out into the Aion. During these events, the [[Dead Mother]] could be heard screaming from somewhere out across the waters.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The [[Aion]] is a depth located beneath the debris field.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c13">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Nakothi]] is rumored to wait at the bottom of the [[Aion]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c16">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Scouts in the [[Aion]] reported a Navigator’s ship{{!}}Navigator's ship.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 17</ref>}}</li>

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Aion is a traversable shallow sea characterized by the presence of the [[Navigator fleet]]'s banners and sails. Navigating this region presents numerous hazards, including the potential for encountering Elder influence while aboard a ship. This location serves as the birthplace of the sparks and is a place where [[Elder cultists]] may reside. While the environment demands great persistence, those who travel through it emerge with increased experience.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">8</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Aion]] contains many hazards.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 6</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Aion]] is a location where one might face Elder influence while on a ship.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c6" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The sparks are born of the [[Aion]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c7">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Aion]] is a location where [[Elder cultists]] might exist.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c8">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|Persistence is an admirable trait on the [[Aion]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 13</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Aion]] is a shallow sea covered by the [[Navigator fleet]]'s sails and banners.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c20">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 20</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The [[Aion]] is a sea that can be traveled.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c21">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 21</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The characters are more experienced on the [[Aion]].<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c24">''Of Dawn and Darkness'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
